audit.whatIsWrong: Stored level chart gave Gwen every row from 1 to 5, but the page's own prose says 'Sejuani out-stats you levels 1-4' and 'Level 6 is where the lane flips your way'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill/Sejuani/Sejuani/Skill/Gwen/Gwen/Skill, which matches the prose.
audit.corrected: Chart realigned to the packet in both layers.

audit.why: Real spikes: her Arctic Assault at 3 (650-range knockup), Gwen's Level 6 Needlework, Riftmaker into her armour-and-HP stack, and her Glacial Prison at two items.
audit.corrected: Each phase why names the ability and its range or cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Everything said 'track Permafrost's cooldown'. Permafrost's cooldown is 1.5 seconds — tracking it is meaningless. Also nothing mentioned Frost Armor's slow immunity against Needlework.
audit.why: Riot: Permafrost 'freezes and stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks' on a 1.5s cooldown at 560 range — the gate is Frost stacks from Winter's Wrath and autos, not a cooldown. Riot on Fury of the North: out of combat she gains Frost Armor granting armor, MR and 'immunity to slows', so Needlework's slow does nothing to a Sejuani who has not been in combat. Permafrost is targeted at 560, so Hallowed Mist denies it outright from outside.
audit.corrected: Stacks-not-cooldown, the 560 targeted range vs Mist, and the Frost Armor slow immunity all written in.

audit.why: Arctic Assault is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s and is her only gap-closer; Winter's Wrath 9/8/7/6/5s.
audit.corrected: Arctic Assault's 12-18s window is now the punish window in the cooldown and trading blocks.

edits.before: Stack snips on the wave and tag him with the true-damage center. Identify how Sejuani contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Both of you are limp at 1. Deny her Winter's Wrath last-hits, farm at the cone tip, and never trade autos into her tankier base stats.

edits.before: E dash-attack-speed makes the snip window real. Only take the trade when Sejuani's Permafrost is down.
edits.after: Winter's Wrath and autos stack Frost; Permafrost stuns at max stacks. Back off on stacks, not on a cooldown.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Sejuani must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit, but Arctic Assault knocks you up from 650 and the stun follows. Contest CS — you have no Mist to answer the engage yet.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Permafrost's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Neutral window: trade in short bursts so Frost never reaches max, then walk. Bank small leads; if behind, farm the cone tip and wait for 6.

edits.before: Needles ramp the longer the fight goes — extended brawls are yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Sejuani's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Needlework ramps over three casts, but Frost Armor ignores slows out of combat — open with Q so she is in combat and the slow actually sticks.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Permafrost's cooldown.
edits.after: Riftmaker is your spike — her armour-and-HP stack is exactly what %-max-HP snips eat.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Sejuani carry threat 5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: You out-duel her in the side lane, but Glacial Prison is a 1300-range bola that pins you for her team — fight where you can see it coming.

edits.before: - Sejuani Permafrost: matchup-defining — Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sejuani Permafrost (1.5s): the cooldown is nothing — max Frost stacks are the gate, so leave before Winter's Wrath caps them. - Arctic Assault (12-18s): her only engage, so punish the miss. - Needlework: kill windows only.

edits.before: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Sejuani with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Sejuani wastes Permafrost — commit the full pattern immediately. Bad trade: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.
edits.after: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Sejuani with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if she turns. Great trade: Arctic Assault whiffs — she has no gap-closer for 12-18s, so commit the full pattern. Bad trade: standing in Winter's Wrath until Frost caps and Permafrost stuns you outside Mist range.

edits.before: Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It is a 1.5s cooldown — the gate is max Frost stacks, so leave before Winter's Wrath caps them.

edits.before: Sejuani wastes Permafrost — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Permafrost is targeted at 560 — from outside she cannot cast it.

edits.before: Track Sejuani's Permafrost: Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. When it is down — Q-snip in the mist.
edits.after: Permafrost needs max Frost stacks, not a cooldown, and is targeted at 560 — from outside your Mist she cannot cast it.

edits.before: Needlework plus Hallowed Mist flips it — mist her Permafrost stun so the follow-up whiffs, slow her with R, and out-sustain via Thousand Cuts healing.
edits.after: Needlework plus Hallowed Mist flips it — Permafrost is targeted at 560 and cannot reach you inside the fog, and her Frost Armor only ignores slows out of combat.
